reviews.shade: Cell Fusion C Laser UV Sunscreen 35mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: A heavier texture sunscreen. This sunscreen contains Zinc Oxide (I think it's within the first five ingredients) so it will leave a white cast! I made the mistake of buying it without reading the ingredients list first. Probably won't be using this on my face since I have other sunscreens that don't leave a white case, but I'm keeping it to use on my hands since I get gel manicures once a month.
reviews.zh: 質地比較厚身嘅防曬。呢款防曬含有氧化鋅（我諗係排喺頭五個成分入面），所以會留低白cast！我買之前冇睇成分表，犯咗錯。我應該唔會喺面上用，因為我有其他唔會留白cast嘅防曬，但係我會留住喺手上用，因為我每個月都做一次啫喱美甲。

reviews.shade: Cell Fusion C Laser UV Sunscreen 35mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: heard this was good, but it was honestly disappointing. it leaves a white cast at first that you will have to work in until it turns transparent. it feels so thick and heavy and greasy. just overall not comfortable to wear at all. not to mention the bottles are also smaller than standard sunscreens so just not worth your money.
reviews.zh: 聽人講呢款好好，但係老實講都幾令人失望。佢一開始會留低白cast，要搓到幾時先會變透明。質地好厚、好重、好油膩，整體嚟講戴落完全唔舒服。另外，支裝仲比普通防曬細，所以真係唔抵呢個價錢。

reviews.shade: Cell Fusion C Laser UV Sunscreen 35mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: I’ve heard a lot of good reviews about this sunscreen so I bought it. It’s very THICK. If you’re not extremely pale it will leave a big white cast. When it comes to washing it off you will need a good face wash. Gentle cleansers might not remove all of the product since it’s water proof. I would definitely use this if you’re going to a beach or swimming but daily use no.
reviews.zh: 我聽過好多人讚呢款防曬，所以買咗。佢好厚身。如果你唔係好白皮膚，佢會留低一大片白cast。洗走嗰陣要用一隻好嘅潔面產品。溫和嘅潔面產品可能唔能夠完全洗走，因為佢防水。我一定會喺去海灘或者游水嗰陣用呢款，但係日常就唔會。

reviews.shade: Cell Fusion C Laser UV Sunscreen 35mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: Love this sunscreen so far. My only reason for not giving it 5 stars is due to the white cast it leaves. Now, when applying, I use two fingers' worth If that makes sense. I am fairly pale but even so it is noticeable on my face. This also my be because the sunscreen itself is thick like the Laroche Posay Cicaplast balm.
reviews.zh: 到目前為止好鍾意呢款防曬。我唔俾五星嘅唯一原因，係佢留低嘅白cast。而家塗嗰陣，我會用兩隻手指嘅份量（如果你明我意思）。我皮膚都幾白，不過都仍然喺面上睇得出。亦可能因為防曬本身都厚身，好似 Laroche Posay Cicaplast 護膚膏咁。

reviews.shade: Cell Fusion C Laser UV Sunscreen 35mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: This product is pretty decent, since it is a hybrid sunscreen it may feel a bit thicker and have more of a layer than a regular lightweight sunscreen. However, I would say this is a great product to use when your skin is sensitive, it protects it from the sun and helps it get back to its normal state
reviews.zh: 呢款產品幾唔錯。因為係混合型防曬，所以可能比普通輕盈防曬稍為厚身，亦會有多啲薄膜感。不過，我覺得呢款好適合皮膚敏感嗰陣用，佢可以保護皮膚免受陽光傷害，幫助皮膚回復正常狀態。

reviews.shade: Cell Fusion C Laser UV Sunscreen 35mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: This is very well known in Korea and i tried the 50ml first but since i alternate different sunscreens at the same period i don’t want to have it open for more than 6 months so decided to get the 35ml and this was a great opportunity to get the duo. This isn’t a perfect base for makeup I don’t think it goes well with makeup honestly but can be used as a tone up base since it does have a bit of cast. None the less I like to use it since I use retinol in my routine. I used it on days I know i will be out and sweating and would wet my face. Needs double cleaning in my opinion.
reviews.zh: 呢款喺韓國好有名，我先試咗50ml，但係因為我同一段時間會輪流用唔同嘅防曬，我唔想開咗超過6個月，所以就揀咗35ml，而且呢個係買套裝嘅好機會。老實講，呢款唔係化妝嘅完美打底，我覺得同化妝配合唔算好，但可以當作提亮打底嚟用，因為佢有少少cast。不過我仍然鍾意用，因為我嘅護膚程序有用 retinol。我用喺知道自己會外出、會出汗、會弄濕面部嗰啲日子。我認為需要雙重潔面。

reviews.shade: Cell Fusion C Laser UV Sunscreen 35mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: Such an interesting sunscreen. Tried many hybrid sunscreen but always it’s a disappointment. Finally this will be my best hybrid sunscreen. Once rub in my whole face show white cast and freak me out, but like magic within a minute start become disappear but only slightly shiny and brighten up my skin tone. I dislike the shiny effect but surprisingly after half and hour it become matte which I like. Whole day my face still stay fresh no sticky or oily feeling. Definitely will repurchase. Doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin at all.
reviews.zh: 好有趣嘅防曬。試過好多款混合型防曬，但係每次都令人失望。終於呢款會成為我最好嘅混合型防曬。一搓喺成張面上，就會見到白cast，嚇我一跳，但係好似魔術咁，一分鐘內就開始消失，只係輕微咁有啲光澤，並且提亮咗膚色。我唔鍾意閃亮嘅效果，但係令人驚訝嘅係，半個鐘之後就變成霧面，我好鍾意。成日都覺得面好清新，冇黏膩或者油膩感。一定會再買。對我嘅敏感皮膚完全冇刺激。

reviews.shade: Cell Fusion C Laser UV Sunscreen 35mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: Smaller than I expected. It’s smaller than other Korean sunscreens but that makes it great for travel! I didn’t mind it was small since it came in a set of 2. It has a velvet finish and absorbs into the skin well. It’s moisturizing without being greasy
reviews.zh: 比我想像中細。比其他韓國防曬細，不過咁樣就好適合旅行帶住！我唔介意佢細，因為係兩支裝。質地係絲絨感嘅霧面效果，吸收得好好。滋潤但唔油膩。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
